hooks.text: 通过格挡、闪避与幽冥冲刺规避攻击，再把握时机致命反击
hooks.excerpt: Parry, dodge, and execute Ethereal Dash to evade attacks, then counter with lethal strikes. Every decision—timing, resource allocation, and positioning—deepens the strategic depth of encounters.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 与剑士、游侠、守卫和盗贼四名亡魂契约，穿障、伏击或移维避死
hooks.excerpt: The Soul Companion system offers diverse combat strategies, featuring four distinct spectral allies: Swordsman, Ranger, Guardian, and Rogue. Harness their abilities to phase through obstacles, ambush foes from the netherworld, or evade fatal blows by shifting dimensions.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 手持连接人间与冥界的禁忌冥灯，与战死同伴灵魂缔结契约
hooks.excerpt: Control the survivor of a catastrophic disaster, wielding the Nether Lantern—a forbidden artifact bridging the mortal realm and the netherworld—to forge pacts with the souls of deceased allies.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
